title: Karnataka High Court seeks SIT's response to Prajwal Revanna's bail plea in nude video call case
description: The Karnataka High Court on Friday sought a response from a Special Investigation Team (SIT) to a bail plea filed by former Hassan Member of Parliament (MP) Prajwal Revanna in connection with a case involving allegations that he coerced a woman into appearing nude during video calls [Prajwal Revanna Vs State of Karnataka].Justice M Nagaprasanna has issued notice to the SIT which is investigating the matter. The Court directed the SIT to file its objections and listed the case next on July 3.Just
